notes: Built by Harriet Bullitt as a rebuilt 1930s camp, with a large collection of Northwest art across the grounds. 58 guest rooms, nine meeting rooms and more than 10,000 sq ft of function space seating 30-190. A Cvent listing quotes inclusive group rates 'often start at just $195 per person'. The photos are the site's own, credited to Erik Sven Photography.
